placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for deployment controls and quality review gates.
placements.title: Release Verification and Deployment Controls
placements.frame: What policies, ownership, and verification gates govern release deployment across environments?

placements.title: Mandatory signed manifests enforce deployment integrity across staging and production
placements.frame: How do signed release manifests and verified gates prevent untrusted artifacts from shipping?
placements.why: Quinton mandates signed release manifests for Meridian deployments to prevent unsigned artifacts from reaching staging and production, which Xena ratifies as an official gate decision.
